item.description:
Release v5.2.0

Changes since v5.1.3

  • feat: add DebugBadgePlugin to show debug indicator in toolbar
  • feat: add projectPath parameter to createConversation
  • feat(AgentTurnRunnerPlugin): add multi-language support (en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant)
  • feat(agentturnrunnerplugin): persist outgoing requests to disk (SwiftData) and add settings view
  • feat(AgentTurnRunnerPlugin)() persist outgoing requests to disk (SwiftData) and add settings view
  • feat(conversationspeedplugin): add average speed display in popover
  • feat(conversationspeedplugin): add conversation speed trend line chart
  • feat(goaltaskplugin): integrate sidebar view and toolbar button into chat section
  • feat(GoalTaskPlugin): integrate sidebar view and toolbar button into chat section
  • feat(idletimeplugin): refactor ActivityHeatStripView layout with proportional time axis labels
  • feat(LLMKit): add cache tokens support for prompt caching
  • feat(LumiKernel): add cache token metadata keys
  • feat(lumiplugin): add willSendToLLM hook for pre-request message modification
  • feat(LumiPlugin)() add willSendToLLM hook for pre-request message modification
  • feat(MessageRenderer): display cache hit rate in message metadata
  • feat(messagerenderer/messagesender): add kernel-based resendMessage API
  • fix(ProjectsPlugin): ensure syncToKernel called on MainActor
  • refactor: add providerID and modelName to ConversationStore
  • refactor: add providerID and modelName to createConversation protocol
  • refactor: auto-associate current provider and model on conversation creation
